column1: # Every version of a pack-built mod ever released, and the sha1 it had.
# APPEND-ONLY. A row is never edited and never deleted. If a line here is wrong,
# the fix is a new version, not a corrected row - the whole value of this file is
# that it remembers what a version string meant the first time it was used.
# A version appearing twice with two different sha1s is the bug this file exists to
